root.slicerDesc: Pick a slicer for 3D model downloads.
root.engravingDesc: Pick a laser app for vector and image files.
root.themeDesc: Switch between light, dark, and neon colors.
root.networkDesc: Point the app at a different API address, if needed.
root.previewsDesc: Choose automatic, on-demand, or disabled preview generation.
root.storageDesc: Organize files with folders, model names, creators, tags, and collections.
root.importsDesc: Manage import cookies and scan local folders.
root.languageDesc: Choose the language used throughout PrintStash.

slicer.heading: Slicer
slicer.subtitle: Control the Open in Slicer button for 3D files.
slicer.helperPrefix: Requires the Slicer Bridge helper to be installed on each client to register the printstash-slicer:// protocol. Download the installer from
slicer.helperSuffix: . On Linux, mark the download as executable if prompted.
slicer.footerNote: The Open in Slicer button launches the custom protocol with a signed download URL.

engraving.heading: Engraving Software
engraving.subtitle: Control the Open in Engraving Software button for laser-ready files.
engraving.helperPrefix: Requires the Bridge helper to be installed on each client to register the printstash-engrave:// protocol. Download the installer from
engraving.helperSuffix: . On Linux, mark the download as executable if prompted.
engraving.footerNote: The Open in Engraving Software button launches the custom protocol with a signed download URL.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.subtitle: Choose how PrintStash looks and feels.

network.heading: Network
network.subtitle: PrintStash serves the UI and API from the same address by default — you only need this if the API lives somewhere else.
network.publicUrlDesc: Set this only if the API isn't reachable at the page's own address — for example, if you're hosting the frontend separately from the backend.
network.storedNote: This setting is stored in your browser, so each device can point to a different URL if needed.

storage.heading: Storage Structure
storage.subtitle: Choose how managed model files are organized on disk.
storage.templateDesc: The model name is unique inside its PrintStash folder. Renaming a model also renames its file while preserving the extension.
storage.examplePathsHeading: Example paths (two plates of one print)
storage.examplePathsEmpty: Enter a template to preview its path
storage.reorganizeHint: Mounted no-copy files are skipped. Existing URLs continue to use stable print IDs.
storage.savedNoApply: Storage structure saved for new and updated models.

previews.heading: Model Previews
previews.subtitle: Control background preview work on this browser.
previews.automaticDesc: Load missing previews only as cards enter view, then save them for future visits.
previews.onDemandDesc: Show saved previews immediately and generate missing ones only when requested.
previews.disabledDesc: Never generate card previews. Interactive viewing remains available by opening a model.
previews.footerNote: Embedded 3MF thumbnails and previously generated server thumbnails are always used when available.

imports.heading: Imports
imports.subtitle: Manage session cookies and import local folders.
imports.mountDesc: Index files from the server's mounted volume. Enable the no-copy option to keep files in place and avoid duplicates.
imports.mountNote: Changes apply on the next server restart. In no-copy mode, mounted files stay read-only and renaming is disabled.
imports.mountCopyLabel: Copy files into PrintStash storage (disable to use mounted files directly)
imports.scanDesc: Select a folder from this device (USB included) and import supported files. The folder name becomes a top-level folder, and subfolders stay nested.
imports.scanExtensions: Supported extensions: {{extensions}}. Selecting a folder uploads immediately.
imports.noFilesFoundInFolder: No files found in that folder.
imports.rootFolderCreateFailed: Failed to create the top-level folder.
imports.makerworldDesc: Optional auth for importing MakerWorld models.
imports.makerworldHelp: Paste the Cookie header from a logged-in makerworld.com request to lift download limits. This value is stored only in your browser.
imports.thingiverseDesc: Optional auth for importing Thingiverse models.
imports.thingiverseHelp: Paste your Thingiverse Cookie header to pass Cloudflare checks when importing. This value is stored only in your browser.

language.heading: Interface Language
language.subtitle: Choose the language used throughout PrintStash.
